function.name: submit_client_report
function.description: Call this once you have gathered the caller's name, phone number, and a clear description of the tax/GST problem they need help with. This saves a report for the team to review and prepare a solution — it does not book an appointment or promise a resolution.

service_category.description: Best-fit category, e.g. GST Registration, GST Return Filing, GST Notice, Income Tax Return, Income Tax Notice, TDS/TCS, Business Registration, ROC Compliance, Accounting, Not sure.

problem_summary.description: A clear, specific summary of what the client needs help with, in their own words as much as possible — include any numbers, dates, or notices they mentioned.

urgency.description: Any deadline or urgency the caller mentioned, e.g. 'GST notice due in 5 days', 'No immediate deadline'.
